pooledShip.reason: bank_gate found 2 new cross-card collisions in the gloss direction via the B1-union expansion channel ("רסיס עצ" on אֵגֶל, "משא כבד" on יָצוּעַ). B1 expansions are not raw meaning segments, so they sit outside both the segment index the ambiguity margin consults and the cross-card fitness set. Until that channel is modelled, gloss ships dormant: with every band threshold 0 the typo layer accepts nothing, so a new typo collision is impossible by construction. Cost: 7.06% gloss holdout recall.

pooling.basis: false accepts counted over every dataset row (not holdout only) plus every cross-card bank collision; via=exact acceptances excluded and reported separately because layer 1 runs before any parameter
pooling.note: Each budget point was an independent GA run with its own seed, producing a non-monotonic raw curve (measured: he-word 3.04% at budget 0 in the sweep vs 9.71% in the main run; gloss collapsed to 0.00%). A genome feasible at a tight budget is feasible at every looser one, so each budget reports the best known point across all genomes produced. Shipped = best known point with zero false accepts and zero cross-card collisions.
